en: Black‑and‑white view of a railway station building taken from track level. The station is a two‑storey structure with a dark mansard roof, dormer windows, and a smaller side wing. A platform canopy with columns runs along the facade, and railway tracks occupy the foreground. Trees and a few houses are visible in the background. Printed caption text appears at the lower left edge.
